name: Manipur Tourism Department statistics
owner: Department of Tourism, Government of Manipur
description: Published visitor arrival and departmental reporting. This prototype has no integration with the department. No official figures are loaded, and none are generated in their place.

name: Manipur Tourism public portal
owner: Department of Tourism, Government of Manipur
description: Public destination, accommodation and cultural information used to ground the curated knowledge layer. Referenced during content curation rather than ingested live.

name: Curated Manipur tourism knowledge base
description: Destination records, heritage notes and practical guidance curated from public official material and reviewed before publication. Facts are tagged as documented, oral tradition, interpretation or practical.

name: Platform interaction signals
description: Anonymised searches, destination views, itinerary additions, navigation starts, check-ins and feedback generated by use of this platform. Measures interest on this platform, not total visitor volume.

name: Participating partner reports
description: Availability and capacity reported by participating homestays, hotels and experience providers. Coverage is limited to partners who have opted in.

name: Prototype demo seed
description: Synthetic records seeded so the prototype can demonstrate the workflow end to end. These records describe no real visitor, business or transaction and must never be quoted as a tourism statistic.

name: Deterministic analytics engine
description: Application code that computes demand, concentration, sentiment and capacity measures from the underlying records. Every output states its calculation method and carries the weakest provenance of its inputs.

name: Campaign and capacity simulation
description: Scenario model that projects visitor load against reported partner capacity under explicit assumptions. Output is a scenario, not a measurement.

name: Weather and conditions feed
description: Optional external conditions feed used by adaptive trip re-planning. Not connected in the prototype; the demo uses a controlled local condition instead.
